# Signatures Formalized

> A collaborative, open-source Lean formalization of BLS, OOPS, Proximity Signatures, Schnorr and synchronized Pointcheval–Sanders. Review and development are in progress.

## Current source: 27 October 2026

The current linked revision is 68ad7b4 on main. BLS, OOPS, Proximity, Schnorr and synchronized Pointcheval–Sanders have readable public Game.lean files, named state/request/result interfaces, visible verification and freshness checks, and separate security statements and proofs.

- BLS: [game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/BLS/Game.lean), [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/BLS/Statement.lean); AGM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/BLS/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L13), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/BLS/Game.lean#L21); ROM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/BLS/CaliperCoCDHFamilyStatement.lean#L12), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/BLS/ROM.lean#L75): AGM with DLog reductions; ordinary ROM with a co-CDH reduction. Both routes have complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic proofs.
- OOPS: [game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/OOPS/Game.lean), [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/OOPS/Statement.lean); AGM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/OOPS/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L11), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/OOPS/Game.lean#L6): Complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic AGM proofs, retaining the target-topic degree rule.
- Proximity: [game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Proximity/Game.lean), [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Proximity/Statement.lean); AGM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Proximity/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L24), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/Proximity/Game.lean#L8), [collision](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/Proximity/Game.lean#L17): Complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic AGM proofs, plus the separately measured fresh-collision event. Its probability remains an additional term; the winning game does not reject collisions.
- Schnorr: [game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Schnorr/Game.lean), [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Schnorr/Statement.lean); AGM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Schnorr/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L11), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/Schnorr/Game.lean#L43); ROM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Schnorr/CaliperROMFamilyStatement.lean#L12), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/Schnorr/Game.lean#L58); nonzero-nonce ROM: [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Schnorr/CaliperNonzeroROMFamilyStatement.lean#L10), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/Schnorr/Game.lean#L68): AGM has complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic proofs. Both ordinary ROM routes (full-field and nonzero nonces) are WORK IN PROGRESS for the Caliper migration; their existing abstract-backend security proofs remain available.
- Synchronized Pointcheval–Sanders: [game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/SynchronizedPS/Game.lean), [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/SynchronizedPS/Statement.lean); AGM: [solvers](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/SynchronizedPS/Spec/Reduction.lean), [equality](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/SynchronizedPS/Game.lean#L27): AGM proof with three explicit (1,1)-DLog solvers (the challenge as either key or in the period hashes), bound εX + εY + εH + 1/p. Certified co-signer keys, one honest signature per period, finite period type. Caliper: [budgeted statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/SynchronizedPS/Statement.lean#L45), [model](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/SynchronizedPS/SecurityModel.lean#L19), [wrapper](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/Runtime/Caliper/SyncWrapParameters.lean), [periods](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Proofs/SynchronizedPS/PeriodTransport.lean): the attacker of the single honest signer is bounded by 4·εDL + 2/p for any period type, four executed solvers obtained by wrapping its caller for two weighted schemes with the other key known, with the [asymptotic](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/SynchronizedPS/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L10) family corollary.

Every public game is the shared EUF-CMA experiment (`Model.EufCma.game`) at a scheme and an attacker model, within a declared [query allowance](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/Signatures/Model/QueryAllowance.lean) from which the reduction derives its budgets and loss factors; exact source-game equalities connect each to the game its proof starts from, and the exponent-keeping BLS game is shown equal in distribution to the real one. The repository is split into `Signatures/` (the review surface: models, games, specifications, statements, resource records; 103 modules) and `Proofs/` (proofs, executed reductions and accounting), with an audit test keeping the boundary. Recorded local verification for this revision: `lake build Signatures Proofs SignaturesTest`, 6,134 jobs. Independent review and agreement with the literature remain separate.

Cite the repository at the commit you read.

```bibtex
@software{signature_security_lean_2026,
  author  = {Gurkan, Kobi and {zkSecurity}},

             Proximity, Schnorr and synchronized Pointcheval–Sanders signatures},
  year    = {2026},
  url     = {https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean},
  version = {main, commit 68ad7b4},
  note    = {Machine-checked EUF-CMA bounds with explicit reduction budgets,
             in the random-oracle and algebraic group models. Cite the commit you read.}

```

## Agent contributions

- [Repository Discussions](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/discussions): Read existing threads, then discuss proposed work or share a review. Include the declaration, source revision, assumptions and evidence.
- [Repository](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean): Follow the current contribution and review instructions.
- [Current review guide](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/68ad7b41a73f66160563eadcfe3d54a7269895bd/docs/review-guide.md): Entry points, games, bounds and model limits.
- [agm-lean](https://github.com/zksecurity/agm-lean): The separate Apache-2.0 algebraic group model library for Lean 4 and VCVio. Read its README for the explanation rule and its stated limits.

## Open problems

- Review current game definitions, assumptions, reductions and execution budgets against the papers.
- Develop standard-model proofs for OOPS and Proximity Signatures. The current site presents oracle-based AGM results for these schemes.

Keep proposed results and open assumptions explicit. Successful Lean checks establish the formal statements in their recorded context; correspondence to the papers still needs review.
